toml_config:
instance_name = "probe"
instance_id = "01234567-89ab-cdef-0123-456789abcdef"
hostname = "probe-host"
ipv4 = "10.144.144.5/24"
ipv6_public_addr_auto = true
listeners = ["tcp://0.0.0.0:11010", "udp://0.0.0.0:11010"]
mapped_listeners = ["tcp://203.0.113.5:11223"]
exit_nodes = ["10.144.144.1"]
routes = ["192.168.0.0/16"]
socks5_proxy = "socks5://127.0.0.1:1080"

[network_identity]
network_name = "probe-net"
network_secret = "example-secret-do-not-use"

[[peer]]
uri = "tcp://203.0.113.9:11010"

[[proxy_network]]
cidr = "192.168.50.0/24"
mapped_cidr = "10.50.0.0/24"

[vpn_portal_config]
client_cidr = "10.14.14.0/24"
wireguard_listen = "0.0.0.0:22022"

[[port_forward]]
bind_addr = "127.0.0.1:8080"
dst_addr = "10.144.144.2:80"
proto = "tcp"

[flags]
latency_first = true
use_smoltcp = true
enable_ipv6 = false
enable_kcp_proxy = true
disable_kcp_input = true
enable_quic_proxy = true
disable_quic_input = true
disable_p2p = true
p2p_only = true
lazy_p2p = true
need_p2p = true
bind_device = false
no_tun = true
enable_exit_node = true
relay_all_peer_rpc = true
multi_thread = false
proxy_forward_by_system = true
enable_encryption = true
encryption_algorithm = "aes-gcm"
disable_tcp_hole_punching = true
disable_udp_hole_punching = true
disable_sym_hole_punching = true
enable_udp_broadcast_relay = true
disable_upnp = true
accept_dns = true
private_mode = true
mtu = 1300
instance_recv_bps_limit = 1048576
relay_network_whitelist = "team-* other"
dev_name = "et0"

[acl.acl_v1]

[[acl.acl_v1.chains]]
name = "Inbound"
chain_type = 1
description = "d"
enabled = true
default_action = 2

[[acl.acl_v1.chains.rules]]
name = "web"
description = ""
priority = 1000
enabled = true
protocol = 1
ports = ["80", "8000-8080"]
source_ips = ["10.144.144.0/24"]
destination_ips = []
source_ports = []
action = 1
rate_limit = 0
burst_limit = 0
stateful = true
source_groups = ["admins"]
destination_groups = []

[acl.acl_v1.group]
members = ["admins"]

[[acl.acl_v1.group.declares]]
group_name = "admins"
group_secret = "example-group-secret"
